description: Today's tide on every asset under the rule: crypto breadth and the Core 30 by state (tide in, slack water, tide out), the flips on the newest completed candle, the current Sunday Tide Report, and one row per asset with band, direction, close, the Tideline, distance from it in ATR and percent, candle date and last flip. Filter by band, tier or class; daily by default, weekly with timeframe W. Cached a minute; the rows change a few times a day after each candle completes.

band.description: Only assets in this state: IN (tide in), SLACK (slack water) or OUT (tide out).

class.description: crypto by default; index and commodity are an alpha and not for decisions.

limit.description: At most this many asset rows.

tier.description: core: the 30 most liquid crypto assets; extended: the other 110.

timeframe.description: D for daily candles (default), W for weekly.

name: snapshot
title: Market snapshot
